$comment: Failures known NOT to be compiler defects, matched by DIFF SIGNATURE rather than case id — the model names cases freshly on every compile, so an id-keyed list would report the same known issues as regressions under new names. A failure counts as expected only when EVERY one of its diffs matches a signature; a case that fails for a known reason AND a new one stays unexpected. Each entry must state why, so the list is auditable and shrinks when a cause is fixed.

signatures.reason: BUG-2022-01: the bed answers 401 where the intent requires 403. This is the known defect the isolation invariant exists to catch — these failing is the tool working, and the 5 minted probes catch it fresh every run.

Bed scope (DESIGN.md §8): the fixture implements the semantics the 2022 corpus exercised, not the Groovy language. A loop, conditional, invoked function, or instantiated class completes with a null result. These cases are correct about the real service; closing the gap would mean writing an interpreter.
